$comment: Files, or named tests of a file, of the v1.3.0 test suite that scripts/run-compat.ts does not run against the current sources. Every entry carries a reason; a behaviour change inherited from the engine also names the compatibility-ledger entry of pdfnative 1.9.0 (release-notes/v1.9.0.md, Upgrade section, carried into release-notes/v1.4.0.md) that documents and justifies it. An entry without a ledger entry tests the repository tree or pins an inventory that grows by design, not renderer behaviour. An entry with `tests` keeps the file running and deselects only those tests (vitest -t, full name match), so one moved assertion never silences a suite. Keep this list as short as the ledger: an exclusion that outlives its ledger entry is a hidden breaking change.

exclude.reason: Repository-tree tests of the 1.3.0 tree (workflow pins, gate steps, guard rules, verify-docs over the 1.3.0 docs, agent configuration), not renderer behaviour — the current suite covers today's tree.

Reads the sample PDFs the 1.3.0 generators wrote into test-output/ and the 1.3.0 byte manifest; the current suite holds the current generators to the current chain, whose carried-forward entries are the 1.3.0 bytes.
Pins the 1.3.0 version in lock-step across package.json, src/version.ts, the schema $id and the manifest; the current suite pins 1.4.0 the same way.
Asserts the engine floor text of 1.3.0 (pdfnative >= 1.8.0) in doctor()'s findings; the floor moved to 1.9.0 with the peer pin, and the current suite asserts the new text.

Its inline snapshot pins the exact 1.3.0 export list, which grows by design in a minor; the superset proof against the frozen 1.2.0 baseline (tests/regression/baselines/api-surface.v1.2.0.json) runs in the current suite.

tests: identifies itself and pins the contract
lists every top-level DocSpec field, the 1.3.0 ones last
detects the 1.8.0 engine through a capability probe
exclude.reason: Three tests pin the 1.3.0 inventory: contract.engine '^1.8.0', the 18-field DocSpec list ending at creationDate, and the 1.8.0 doctor probe name — each grows by design with the 1.9.0 pin (direction is the 19th field; the probe is resolveBidiLevels), and tests/manifest-superset.test.ts proves the superset in the current suite. The other 37 tests of the file — the error taxonomy, toErrorEnvelope, doctor's shape and the whole validateSpec suite — still run.

One test pins the exact 1.3.0 list of shared $defs (seven); 1.4.0 adds processColor — the process-only colour definition of outline bookmark colours — after color, an inventory that grows by design and that the current suite pins at eight. The subject list, the $id, every block branch and the 1.8.0 / 1.9.0 sugar assertions of the file still run.
Holds tests/regression/engine-surface.json to the pdfnative 1.8.0 release entry; the matrix follows the 1.9.0 pin and is checked by the current suite.

One describe block stats the 1.3.0 repository tree (AGENTS.md, the on-demand docs, .claude/hooks, the skills) rather than renderer behaviour — the current suite covers today's tree. The runtime half (aiGovernancePolicy() against .github/ai-governance.json) still runs.

tests: keeps every contract key, with only the accepted deltas changing
exclude.reason: One test lists contract.engine '^1.8.0' as the accepted delta from 1.2.0; the peer pin is '^1.9.0' since 1.4.0 and the current suite accepts that value. Every other 1.2.0 ⊆ current proof of the file still runs.

tests: lists every top-level DocSpec field, 1.2.0 order first then appended
exposes the full rule set, in registry order
exclude.reason: Two tests pin the exact 1.3.0 inventories (18 DocSpec fields, 37 lint rules); 1.4.0 appends `direction` and four rules (L_CHART_SERIES_COLORS, L_SPOT_UNDECLARED, L_SPOT_INK_MIX, L_PDFA_JPX_IMAGE) after them — additive growth the current suite pins at the new counts, with every 1.3.0 entry in its place. The block grammar, the component table and the ordering checks of the file still run.

tests: Hausa, Yoruba, Igbo and Swahili render on the bundled latin module
exclude.reason: One test asserts a Latin document with the bundled Noto Sans is larger than 20 KB as its proof that the font was embedded; the engine's lean subsets (a cmap over the kept glyphs, a format-3 post, no gasp, compact CIDs) bring the same file to about 14 KB. The current suite holds the embedding fact through the font dictionary instead of a byte floor.

tests: renders the PDF/A-2b document, embedded font included, to real bytes
exclude.reason: One test asserts the tagged PDF/A-2b document is larger than 50 KB as its proof that the font was embedded; the engine's lean subsets and compact CID space bring it to about 18 KB, with the font still embedded. Every other PDF/UA and PDF/A assertion of the file still runs.

tests: writes a PDF 1.6 file with the PDF/X output intent and a known trapping state
exclude.reason: One test asserts the PDF/X-4 document is larger than 50 KB as its embedding proof (lean subsets, C6; about 24 KB now, the font still embedded). One test expects L_PDFX_TAGGED_CONFLICT on pdfx + tagged: the engine accepts tagged 'pdfa2b' / 'pdfa2u' next to pdfx 'pdfx4' since 1.9.0 (C14), so the rule fires only for the levels the engine still refuses, and the current suite asserts the new split. The round-trip, the DocSpec parity and every other coherence rule of the file still run.

One test expects the single 1.8.0 refusal message for pdfx + tagged; the engine accepts the PDF/A-2b/2u + PDF/X-4 combination since 1.9.0 and refuses 1b and 3b with one message each, which the rule now mirrors. The other 36 rule tests and their clean cases still run.
